name: Kimi K3
description: The 2.8T NVIDIA NVFP4 flagship demonstration for inference beyond physical memory.
limitations: Beta FTW preparation must preserve the checkpoint's mixed representation: NVFP4 routed experts, 128x128 block-FP8 attention projections, and the original precision of remaining tensors.
The native Kimi loader currently supports Moonshot's compressed-tensors MXFP4 layout; NVIDIA's ModelOpt mixed NVFP4/FP8 tensor layout still requires a dedicated precision-preserving mapping.
Full-checkpoint FTW preparation and GPU parity are not yet validated.
No latency promise and no vision support.
